results.description: PromptVault is a decentralized AI prompt registry built on Sui. Submit a prompt → AI evaluates it for clarity, structure, and model-fit → both the original prompt and the evaluation are stored as immutable Walrus blobs. Your connected Sui wallet becomes the author. Forks carry real on-chain lineage. Everything is public, permanent, and verifiable.

results.name: Zafaraminuddin/knova-core
results.description: Knova Core is the foundational service responsible for ingesting, hashing, and storing immutable knowledge records. This repo focuses strictly on core data integrity and history, not automation or execution.
